eva: Quick a11y pass on the console: two small but important things I noticed with filter chips and toasts. Notes + repro below :eyes: sam: ok — paste repro? eva: Repro: open Model List -> toggle 'Pinned' filter -> press Tab through chips -> observe focus ring disappears on second chip when dark theme enabled. Also open a job success toast, it gets announced twice by screen reader (NVDA) and focus jumps unexpectedly. morgan: thanks. sounds like two issues: focus-visible handling + live region doubling. Can you paste the snippets you're using for chips/toast? sam: chips use button.role=button, tabindex=0 and custom outline via box-shadow for focus. toast is rendered with role="status" and aria-live="polite" and also programmatically focused when created (element.focus()). eva: here's the CSS we used: ```css .chip:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(54, 120, 255, 0.35); } .dark .chip:focus { box-shadow: none; } ``` morgan: aha — `.dark .chip:focus` removing box-shadow is why focus disappears in dark theme. Instead of removing, use a high-contrast outline color that meets AA. Try: ```css .dark .chip:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.9); } ``` Contrast note: gold on dark is OK but run contrast check against background. priya: design comment: would prefer border-style ring instead of gold — maybe use `--focus-accent` token so we keep them consistent across components. morgan: Toast duplication — likely because we do both `role="status"` + `element.focus()`; SRs announce role=status changes and focusing can cause an extra announcement. We should pick one: either leave aria-live and don't focus, or keep focus but set `aria-hidden` on the live region and use `role="alert"` only if it's critical. Recommended change: ```html
Success: model deployed
``` and remove `element.focus()`; make sure the toast has a keyboard-dismissible button that receives focus when user tabs. sam: makes sense. For keyboard users we want to be able to reach the dismiss button without auto-focus on toast. eva: Also noticed the skip link isn't visible on focus unless you tab twice — looks like `:focus` styles for `.skip-to-content` are behind a transform. Quick fix: ensure skip link has visible outline and `transform: none` on focus. morgan: good catch. Also suggest making toasts use `aria-live="polite"` and role="status" (not alert) to avoid interrupting screen reader on non-critical info. For critical errors use `role="alert"` and `aria-live="assertive"`. priya: Accessibility copy nit — toasts reading "Saved" feels vague. Can we change to "Draft saved" or "Autosave successful" so SR users have context? Small tweak but helps. a11y-bot: automated-audit: color-contrast: 2 items failed, focus-visible test: 1 failure, ARIA-liveregion: duplicate-announcements heuristic matched. See /reports/2034567890. eva: action items: - sam: fix `.dark .chip:focus` to use `--focus-accent` and confirm contrast (due EOD) - sam: remove programmatic focus from toasts, ensure dismiss button tabbable - priya: update toast copy variants - morgan: re-run NVDA/VO passes and confirm duplication gone - follow-up thread if anything regresses :+1: sam: will do, thanks. :thumbsup: morgan: leaving a quick note — add tests: keyboard-nav smoke and a small NVDA script that verifies single announcement on toast. eva: awesome, thanks team.
